nodes.label: FVG Pro Elite Strategy
nodes.rationale: Rules-based, multi-confirmation institutional-style model that converts discretionary smart-money trading into scored setups; prioritizes quality (6/6) over quantity.

nodes.label: Fib Retest Sniper Entry
nodes.rationale: Optional secondary filter on the IFVG Model that trades immediacy for precision by waiting for a Fibonacci pullback reaction instead of entering on IFVG confirmation close.

nodes.label: Manipulation Leg Fib Anchor
nodes.rationale: Fib must be anchored to the model's sweep extreme (Point A) and V-shape recovery extreme (Point B), not an arbitrary swing, so the sniper layer integrates with IFVG structure.

nodes.label: Inversion Fair Value Gap Model
nodes.rationale: Formalizes stop-hunt-then-reversal as a fixed four-step sequence; every signal must satisfy all four steps in order or no signal is produced.

nodes.label: Immediate IFVG Entry On Confirmation Close
nodes.rationale: Original model does not use IFVG as a retest zone; signal fires on the candle close that creates the inversion. A Fibonacci retest layer would be an original addition, not a native feature.
nodes.norm_label: immediate ifvg entry on confirmation close

nodes.label: Three Parallel Signal Streams A A+ A++
nodes.rationale: Running three independently configurable streams removes the loose-vs-strict trade-off at signal generation; frequency/quality decisions move downstream to sizing and stream selection.
nodes.norm_label: three parallel signal streams a a+ a++

nodes.label: TP Box Targeting
nodes.rationale: Boxes (zones) around swing levels score real touches more generously than hard lines, avoiding near-miss penalties from feed noise without changing price behavior.

nodes.label: Swing Target BE TP1 TP2 Mapping
nodes.norm_label: swing target be tp1 tp2 mapping

nodes.label: Partial-Exit Engineering
nodes.rationale: Bank partial size at TP1 for higher-frequency wins and let a runner ride toward TP2 for outsized R, instead of picking a single most-likely target.

nodes.label: Custom IFVG Fib Detection Layer
nodes.rationale: None of the surveyed frameworks natively implement FVG/IFVG, sweep+V-shape sequencing, or Fib retest confirmation; that custom signal module is the differentiator.

nodes.label: Degree of Fair Value Gap Metric

nodes.label: Good Combos
nodes.rationale: Preferred setups: AMD + Sweep + Order block; Sweep + FVG + IFVG. Avoid sweeps without confirmation, ignoring AMD structure, and trading FVG with no context.

nodes.label: IFVGs vs FVGs
nodes.rationale: Mark 2 key swing high/low levels near price; find trend line or internal trend line and look for FVG; inversion candle must close above/below the trendline (bearish TL + bullish candle / IFVG closes above) to enter long or short.

nodes.label: Buyer Domination Candle
nodes.rationale: Buyers dominated; sellers pushed price back down to gain control for close (vice versa for sellers).

nodes.label: ORB Setup
nodes.rationale: Mark first 15-minute candle of 9:30–9:45. If price breaks above and closes with strong volume, enter long (reference previous day high/low); vice versa for bearish.

nodes.label: Classic ORB Strategy
nodes.rationale: Draw bullish or bearish trendline from first 15 minutes on 5, 15, 30 charts; as soon as price breaks, retest enter.

nodes.label: Pullback (Retest)
nodes.rationale: Higher probability entry, less risk; name speaks for itself.

nodes.label: 15-Minute Timeframe
nodes.rationale: Sweet spot balance between outcome reliability.

nodes.label: 30–60 Minute Timeframe
nodes.rationale: Best stability, more reliable signals.

nodes.label: Asset Class Characteristics (Forex vs Crypto vs Stocks)
nodes.rationale: Analyze trading volumes, liquidity, and 24-hour price behavior across asset classes.
nodes.norm_label: asset class characteristics (forex vs crypto vs stocks)

nodes.label: Forex
nodes.rationale: Highly liquid and heavily mean-reverting due to central bank interventions; suited to session-based scalping and range trading.

nodes.label: Crypto
nodes.rationale: Highly speculative and trend persistent; suited to trend following, momentum and breakouts, and long-term moving average strategies.

nodes.label: Stocks
nodes.rationale: Drift upward over long periods due to economic growth; suited to gap-up strategies, earnings momentum plays, and long-term trend following.

nodes.norm_label: end of day daily chart analysis

nodes.label: Reverse due to unfair value
nodes.rationale: If price retraces into OTE and simultaneously tests previous day's VAH or VAL, it signals the market is about to reverse due to unfair value.

nodes.label: Anchored VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price)
nodes.rationale: Anchor to swing low that started impulsive move upward, or swing high for downtrend; algorithms heavily defend Anchored VWAP; dynamic VWAP line itself gives entry.

nodes.label: Stop hunt
nodes.rationale: FVG sits below major session low; wait for price to aggressively pierce that low, traps breakout sellers, tap FVG, immediately close back below session low, enter on that close.

nodes.label: ORB (Opening Range Breakout)
nodes.rationale: Most common trade everyday at 9:15, 9:30; move with momentum if chart is bearish or bullish; wait for retest, enter trend accordingly.

nodes.label: Context → Location → Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Establish context (balanced or trending), find location via volume profile LVN overlapping FVG, then confirm with footprint absorption or aggression at the order block. Skipping a step leads to failed signals.

nodes.label: Reading Order: Context → Location → Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Each layer answers a different question depending on the prior answer. Context without location is directionless; location without confirmation is guesswork; confirmation without context is noise. Reading in any other order strips later signals of reliability.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Order Flow Framework
nodes.rationale: Order Flow / Auction Theory, Volume Profile, and Footprint Volume are three resolutions of the same picture (macro to micro), not separate systems.
